dek.text: Every Large Load answered ERCOT's data center questionnaire. Cooling questions drew N/A answers at the highest rate, and a final report is targeted for December 10th.

introduction.text: [ERCOT sent its Data Center State and Community Impact request for information to {{number:c3}} loads](c3). [The market notice that opened it is dated {{date:c32}}](c32), [and it set a response deadline of {{date:c34}}](c34). [It warned that a failure to answer any part would be reported to the utility commission and the Office of the Governor](c35).
[A preliminary summary prepared for the commission's open meeting of {{date:c1}} reports the first results](c1). [Every data slide in it is marked preliminary and subject to change](c2).

paragraphs.text: [{{number:c4}} of {{number:c4:1}} loads submitted the questionnaire. Their answers cover about {{number:c4:3}} GW, {{number:c4:4}} of the interconnection capacity requested](c4). [{{number:c5}} came in on time and {{number:c5:4}} late](c5), [and {{number:c6}} Medium Load responses had not been submitted](c6).

[All {{number:c7}} Large Loads responded. Large Loads are those of {{number:c7:1}} MW or greater](c7). [Large Loads represent about {{number:c8}} of the capacity requested](c8). [Among them, {{number:c9}} projects are requesting more than {{number:c9:2}} GW each. They represent {{number:c9:1}} of capacity](c9).

[Requests span every ERCOT load zone. West Texas holds the plurality with {{number:c10}} of capacity, {{number:c10:1}} GW](c10). [The zone breakdown counts {{number:c15}} loads, and a load's actual zone is set at interconnection and may differ](c15). [It leaves out the load zones of Non-Opt-In Entities](c16).

[Respondents answered {{number:c17}} of nearly {{number:c17:1}} questions](c17). [The N/A rate was slightly lower among Large Loads, about {{number:c19}}, than among Medium Loads, about {{number:c19:1}}](c19).

[Cooling questions drew N/A answers at a higher rate than any other kind. Respondents indicated that many projects had not determined their final cooling configuration](c18). [Projects asking to energize in {{number:c20}} or later answered N/A {{number:c20:1}} more often than projects due sooner](c20). The summary doesn't say how much of the requested capacity sits behind an undecided cooling design.

[The Texas Water Development Board's executive administrator authorized ERCOT to ask the questionnaire's Section C questions on the board's behalf](c36). The preliminary summary reports answer rates. It doesn't publish what any project said about water or cooling.

sections.heading: A second round on Batch Zero

paragraphs.text: [In the separate Batch Zero eligibility verification, groups within ERCOT and outside legal counsel reviewed responses from {{number:c24}} developers](c24). [ERCOT expects to send {{number:c25}} of them a second round of questions](c25), [with a {{number:c26}} business day deadline to explain any deficiencies](c26).

The review isn't finished. [Common issues so far include proving site control](c29) [and confirming the amount of financial security posted](c31). [ERCOT said it had to complete the review in November to file a report with the commission on {{date:c27}}](c27).

[ERCOT says detailed analysis is under way and that it is targeting a published final report on {{date:c23}}](c23). Until the final report is out, the counts here remain preliminary and the cooling answers remain unpublished.
